text:
California Department of Social Services 2027-28 General Child Care and
  Development Program (CCTR) – Approval of Submission of a Continued
  Funding and Expansion Application for Contract Renewal; Adopt Resolution
summary: Approves applying to the state for continued funding and expansion of the 2027-28 General Child Care and Development Program contract, and adopts the accompanying resolution.

details.action: approve funding application for contract renewal; adopt resolution
